purpose: Dependency inventory for the real installed GMod Q menu, Tool Gun, Physgun-visible hooks and notification system.
findings: The real Q/spawn menu is substantially implemented in Lua/Derma under sandbox spawnmenu plus the spawnmenu module.
The Tool Gun is script-rich and registers tool-menu entries through spawnmenu APIs.
Physgun pickup/drop/freeze/draw hooks are script-visible, but weapon_physgun core manipulation is engine-native and remains an Astra/IDA 6.8 task.
GMod notification Lua is the correct source for notification bubbles instead of Fallout prompts.
